Fieldnote R2 recorder review

The fictional Fieldnote R2 is a compact recorder designed around physical controls. Its display remains readable outdoors, and recordings can be copied over a standard storage interface.

Score: 8/10

What works

  • Clear gain controls with useful detents
  • Predictable file naming
  • Replaceable battery pack

What does not

  • Slow waveform previews
  • No marker export in the first firmware release

Verdict

The recorder is easy to understand and dependable for basic field work. Buyers who need extensive metadata editing should wait for a software update.
